_about: Shared user-facing text for the website (web/src/copy.js) and the iOS app (Copy.swift). Edit text here only. {app} is replaced with app.name.
app.name: Dinnerdesk
recipe.kitchen-tested.explanation: We cooked this recipe in our own kitchen and made sure it works as written.
app.tagline: Pick your favorite meals, shop once, cook without thinking.
settings.gold-star: Kitchen-tested identifies recipes marked by {app} as tried in our kitchen. The mark applies to the recipe, independently of its photos. Tap the recipe’s Kitchen-tested chip to learn more; the photo’s info button shows its credit and source.
settings.invite-link: Someone new opens this link and creates an account in your household, with the same recipes, plan, and grocery list. Someone who already has an account pastes this same link into Join a household. Expires in 7 days, one-time use.
settings.sign-out-everywhere: Signs out every device using this account — use this if a phone or laptop was lost or you just changed your password and want to be sure.
feedback-tip.title: Found something off? Send us a screenshot
feedback-tip.intro: You’re testing an early version of {app}. A screenshot with a short note is the fastest way to tell us what to fix.
feedback-tip.1.title: Take a screenshot
feedback-tip.1: Press the side button and volume up at the same time.
feedback-tip.2.title: Tap the preview
feedback-tip.2: It shows in the bottom-left corner for a few seconds.
feedback-tip.3.title: Choose Share Beta Feedback
feedback-tip.3: There are two ways. Use whichever you see.
feedback-tip.3.done: Tap Done, then Share Beta Feedback… at the top of the menu.
feedback-tip.3.share: Tap Share, then Share Beta Feedback in the row of buttons.
feedback-tip.4.title: Add a note and send
feedback-tip.4: Say what you expected to happen. It goes straight to the developer with your screenshot.
tester-alerts.title: Too many emails or notifications?
tester-alerts.intro: We appreciate your feedback and want you to know when we’ve made improvements. But we understand that sometimes there are too many emails or notifications. Here’s how you can change that.
tester-alerts.1.title: Open TestFlight
tester-alerts.1: Open the TestFlight app and tap {app}.
tester-alerts.2.title: Turn off emails
tester-alerts.2: On the {app} page, switch off Email Notifications.
tester-alerts.3.title: Turn off notifications
tester-alerts.3: In the Settings app, go to Notifications › TestFlight and switch off Allow Notifications.
tester-alerts.4.title: Keep Automatic Updates on
tester-alerts.4: We recommend turning on Automatic Updates on the {app} page in TestFlight, so you get fixes without having to check.
tour.update.title: What’s new in {app}
tour.update: Suggested plans are now less likely to be all one protein or all one kind of dish. Grocery optimizing had been weighted too heavily, causing suggestions to contain all one type of dish (all salmon dishes, all potato dishes etc.) Filters can now choose which cuisines to suggest, and which proteins to offer more or less of. 58 new recipes are in the app.
tour.welcome: Quick start walks through eat and how. Taste Lab is the swipe kitchen. Skip anytime.
tour.filters.title: What do you eat?
tour.filters: Tap what fits, and suggestions are made for your household. Change this anytime in Settings → Filters.
tour.ai.title: How we use AI
tour.ai.more: More about how we use AI
tour.ai.1.title: Are these recipes AI-generated?
tour.ai.1: No. These are real recipes developed by people and shared publicly by reliable sources.
tour.ai.2.title: AI photos and wording
tour.ai.2: We use AI to create representative photos and rewrite descriptions and instructions, rather than copy the source’s photos or exact wording. The photos are inspiration, not the exact result.
tour.ai.3.title: Made on our own computer
tour.ai.3: Our AI runs on a machine we own, not in a data center.
tour.ai.4.title: Reviewed by our team
tour.ai.4: Our team reviews the AI-generated photos and wording. We’re working through cooking the recipes, checking ingredients and steps, and replacing AI images with our own photos.
tour.how.1.title: Suggestions
tour.how.1: Get four dinners matched to your household’s tastes and diet. No browsing needed.
tour.how.2.title: Review and approve
tour.how.2: Swap any meal you don’t want, then approve. Your current plan stays until you do.
tour.how.3.title: Grocery
tour.how.3: Your list is built from the plan, with amounts combined. Pantry items can start checked off. Tap a store at the top to shop one store at a time.
tour.how.4.title: Weekend prep
tour.how.4: When you have time, chop, measure and make sauces ahead. On weeknights, just cook.
tour.how.5.title: Recipes and tips
tour.how.5: Browse recipes or add your own. Purple cards with a ★ explain a feature right where you use it.
tour.how.6.title: Taste Lab
tour.how.6: Swipe meals you’d cook or pass on to sharpen your suggestions. Find it anytime under More.
plan.empty: Nothing selected yet. Add meals from Recipes.
prep.about: Built from this plan’s meals. Chop and batch now; cook fresh later in the week.
prep.empty: No prep yet. Add meals on Plan.
grocery.empty: Add meals on Plan and they show up here.
grocery.stores: Add or remove stores and assign each grocery item.
grocery.aisles: Set aisle numbers and order, then put each grocery item in an aisle.
kitchen.pantry-add: Check what you have. Saves as you go.
kitchen.always-checked: Things you always have on hand, like salt or oil. They still appear on your grocery list, but already checked off, so you can skip them unless you run low.
kitchen.substitutions: When a recipe calls for one item, put another on your grocery list instead.
kitchen.store-chips: Tap a store to remove it.
kitchen.store-per-item: Your choice applies to every grocery list from now on.
kitchen.aisle-order: Drag aisles into the order you walk the store. Your grocery list follows this order.
kitchen.templates: Pick a format. Recipe bodies live in the cookbook.
recipes.ai-photo: This photo was made with AI. It shows the kind of dish, not this exact recipe.
recipes.shared-photo: This photo is from a similar recipe, so it may not match this one exactly.
recipe-editor.steps: `- ` starts a bullet. Amounts for this step are the list under the instruction on Cook. Empty amounts is fine.
ingredient-review.merge: Check only the names that mean the same grocery item.
